declarations.description:
A keyboard-accessible date-range calendar inspired by travel booking pickers. It shows one or two consecutive
months, starts a range on the first activation, completes it on the second, and starts over on the third. With
`mode="single"` it picks one date into `value`; with `mode="multiple"` each activation toggles a date in `value`
(a comma-separated list). `marked` dates get a dot, and `renderDay` adds content under any day's number. Dates are
local-calendar ISO strings (`YYYY-MM-DD`), so they do not shift across time zones. Arrow keys move by day or week,
Home/End move within the week, and Page Up/Page Down change month.

When `name` is present, the start date is submitted under that name and the end date under `end-name` (or
`${name}-end`). In `single` mode `value` is submitted under `name`, and in `multiple` mode each date is submitted
under `name`. `required` requires a complete range, or at least one date. Use `min` and `max` to constrain availability:
days outside them are disabled, and the month navigation stops at the months that contain them.
declarations.name: DateSelector

cssProperties.name: --c2-date-selector--min-width

cssProperties.description: Shown while an enclosing `c2-form-field` shows an error.
cssProperties.name: --c2-date-selector__error--border

members.name: field
members.description: Label and description handed down by an enclosing `c2-form-field`.

members.name: from
members.description: Start of the selected range as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

members.name: to
members.description: End of the selected range as `YYYY-MM-DD`; empty while the range is incomplete.

members.name: min
members.description: Earliest selectable date as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

members.name: max
members.description: Latest selectable date as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

members.name: locale
members.description: Locale used for month, weekday and accessible date labels. Defaults to the document language.

members.name: weekStart
members.description: First day of each calendar week.

members.name: mode
members.description: What a click picks: a `range` (`from`/`to`), one date (`single`) or any number of dates (`multiple`) in `value`.

members.name: value
members.description:
The selection outside `range` mode: one `YYYY-MM-DD` date in `single` mode, the dates in ascending order separated
by commas in `multiple` mode. Unused in `range` mode, which keeps `from` and `to`.

members.name: marked
members.description: Dates drawn with a dot (events, availability), as `YYYY-MM-DD`: an array, or `;`-separated / JSON in the attribute.

members.name: renderDay
members.description: Adds content under each day's number. The day button, its label and its selection stay the component's.

members.name: months
members.description: Number of consecutive months shown; clamped to one or two.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name for the start date.

members.name: endName
members.description: Form field name for the end date. Defaults to `${name}-end`.

members.name: required
members.description: Requires both endpoints when the selector participates in a form.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Prevents navigation and selection and excludes the control from form submission.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name for the complete calendar.

members.name: selectedDates
members.description: The valid dates of `value`, in the order written.

members.name: canNavigate
members.description: Whether moving the view by `amount` months would still show a selectable day within `min`/`max`.

members.name: focus
members.description: Moves focus into the calendar: to a selected day, else today, else the first available day shown.

events.name: input
events.description: Fired after either endpoint changes, with `from` and `to` already updated.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired with `input`; `detail` contains the ISO `from` and `to` values.
